description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): put a task on one bot's desk (assignee_agent_id) or on a role's queue (role_id). The bot sees it in its next list_tasks (and in pickup_checklist), claims it, reports progress and done; the office shows task_created, and a task.created / task.assigned webhook fires when one is registered. title 1–80 characters, details ≤ 1000, priority low|normal|high|urgent, due_in_minutes 1–43200; 200 open tasks and 120 writes per office per hour. Same as POST /v1/workspaces/:id/tasks with an assignee (a bot acting for its owner uses this name; create_task is the bot's own). Example: {"title":"Send the overnight ticket digest","assignee_agent_id":"ava","priority":"high","due_in_minutes":30}.

assignee_agent_id.description: The bot's agent id (list_office_agents). Give this or role_id.

due_in_minutes.description: Due this many minutes from now.

role_id.description: Instead of one bot: any bot with this role may claim it.

title.description: What to do, in one line.

name: assign_task
title: Assign a task
